title: SDD Global State (sdd/global.json)
description: Central project state: modules and monorepo layout. Written by sdd-orchestrator (cycle start) and sdd-reviewer (cycle close). Cycle numbering is per-spec (cycles/cycle-XX), there is no global cycle counter.

profile.description: Working profile (optional, default team). team = full cycles (brief/functional/planner/architect, one role per document) unless a request carries [LITE]. solo = the orchestrator opens flow: lite cycles (single actor, plan.md instead of the four documents) unless the spec or a [FULL] prefix asks for full. Switched by the sdd-steward on request.

libs.description: Name -> description map, same shape as `apps`, so the docs viewer can discover each lib's context. A plain string is still accepted for kits installed before this shape existed, but in that form libs are not listed in sdd:docs.

tools.description: Optional. Name -> description map, same shape as `apps` and `libs`, so the docs viewer can discover each tool's context under sdd/context/tools/. Absent means the repo registers no tools as SDD subprojects; a plain string is accepted but in that form tools are not listed in sdd:docs.

cycles_completed.description: Number of cycles of THIS spec completed (per-spec numbering).
